# Lunar Light Awakening

> Wellness and crystal shop in Schofield, Wisconsin offering stones, jewelry, herbal products, workshops, and practitioner services including Reiki, sound healing, and crystal therapy.

## What we offer

- Sacred stones and crystals for aesthetic enjoyment or metaphysical use
- Jewelry and herbal products
- Healing arts: Reiki, sound healing, crystal therapy through partnered practitioners
- Classes and workshops in a dedicated classroom space
